jobs.title: Memory Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Reminiscence Coordinator**
============================


The **Reminiscence Coordinator** leads the memory care neighborhood, ensuring residents with Alzheimer’s and dementia receive compassionate, individualized care and engaging activities.


Responsibilities include managing daily operations in compliance with regulations and company standards, supporting families through meetings and education, and developing dementia\-appropriate programming to promote purposeful days.


The role involves collaborating with clinical leadership to meet care needs, monitoring quality indicators such as behaviors and medication management, and overseeing staffing, training, and performance management.


Additional duties include managing the department budget, ensuring regulatory compliance, and supporting a strong, trained team dedicated to resident\-centered care.


Qualifications include experience in memory care or dementia care, strong leadership skills, and a compassionate approach. Skills required are excellent communication, team management, and problem\-solving abilities.


The position offers a competitive pay range, benefits such as health plans, retirement, paid time off, tuition reimbursement, and performance bonuses.

jobs.title: Part-Time Client Care Manager
jobs.description:
**Benefits:**
* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Opportunity for advancement
* Vision insurance
**HomeWell Care Services – Chula Vista, CA**  

**Employment Type:** Part\-Time, W\-2  

**Hours:** 15–20 hours per week  

**Pay:** $27–$36 per hour, depending on credentials and experience  

**Location:** Chula Vista / South Bay San Diego and surrounding areas  

About the Position  

HomeWell Care Services provides personalized, non\-medical in\-home care that helps seniors and other adults remain safe, comfortable, and independent at home.  

We are seeking an experienced and compassionate **Part\-Time Client Care Manager** to oversee client\-care quality, support caregivers, communicate with families, and ensure each client's Plan of Care continues to meet their needs.  

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced **CNA or LVN** ready to move into care coordination, client relations, caregiver support, and quality assurance.  

This is primarily a **care\-management position, not a direct\-care caregiving position**.  

Key Responsibilities  

* Conduct in\-home client assessments and reassessments.
* Develop, review, and update individualized Plans of Care.
* Conduct supervisory and quality\-assurance visits.
* Follow up with clients and families after new starts of care.
* Monitor client satisfaction and identify concerns before they escalate.
* Recognize and report changes in clients' condition, safety, mobility, behavior, or care needs.
* Assist with caregiver\-client matching based on skills, personality, and client needs.
* Work closely with the Scheduler/Care Coordinator regarding client and caregiver concerns.
* Coach caregivers on Plans of Care, client expectations, professionalism, and performance.
* Address client and family concerns promptly and professionally.
* Support new starts of care and help ensure a smooth transition.
* Maintain accurate and timely documentation of assessments, visits, incidents, and follow\-ups.
* Escalate significant client or caregiver concerns appropriately.
* Maintain confidentiality and professional boundaries.

Preferred Qualifications  

* **Current California CNA certification or LVN license preferred.**
* Minimum 2 years of senior\-care experience, preferably in home care, senior living, hospice, home health, skilled nursing, or a related setting.
* Experience with client assessments, care coordination, supervisory visits, caregiver supervision, or case management preferred.
* Experience with dementia, Alzheimer's disease, chronic conditions, and mobility limitations.
* Strong communication, documentation, organization, and problem\-solving skills.
* Confident communicating with clients, families, and caregivers.
* Comfortable coaching caregivers and addressing performance concerns.
* Valid California driver's license, reliable transportation, and ability to travel throughout the service area.

Ideal Candidate  

We are looking for someone who is **compassionate, confident, dependable, organized, and accountable**.  

The ideal candidate is comfortable visiting clients in their homes, assessing how services are going, communicating with families, coaching caregivers, recognizing changes in client needs, and following concerns through resolution.  

Schedule \& Compensation  

Approximately **15–20 hours per week**, primarily weekdays, with flexibility for assessments, supervisory visits, and new starts of care.  

**Pay: $27–$36 per hour**, based on credentials and relevant experience.  

* Experienced CNA/senior\-care professional: approximately **$27–$30/hour**
* Experienced LVN with strong care\-management experience: approximately **$31–$36/hour**

Mileage reimbursement is provided for authorized business travel in accordance with company policy.  

Why Join HomeWell?  

This is an opportunity to move beyond traditional direct caregiving and make a broader impact on clients, families, and caregivers. As our organization grows, there may be opportunities for increased hours and additional leadership responsibilities.  

**HomeWell Care Services is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**  

If you are an experienced CNA, LVN, or senior\-care professional passionate about excellent client care and working with families and caregivers, we encourage you to apply.

*This franchise is independently owned and operated by a franchisee. Your application will go directly to the franchisee, and all hiring decisions will be made by the management of this franchisee. All inquiries about employment at this franchisee should be made directly to the franchise location, and not to HomeWell Care Service Corporate.*

jobs.title: Hospice RN Case Manager
jobs.description:
Description:

The RN Case Manager is primarily responsible for providing professional nursing care to assigned patients, which includes adults, pediatric and perinatal. With input from the IDT (interdisciplinary team), patient and family, assesses, develops, implements and evaluates the plan of care. Ensures appropriate communication and plan of care coordination to all internal/external customers. Responsible for carrying out the mission, vision, values and commitment to quality of The Elizabeth Hospice.


The Elizabeth Hospice is San Diego's oldest non\-profit hospice of 45 years. We are growing and looking for talented individuals to join our high performing team and support our mission. We serve all of San Diego County and south Riverside County with multiple hospice office locations.


Our Mission: To enhance the quality of life for those nearing the end of life's journey and for those who grieve.

**Work Schedule:** Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m.\-5:00 p.m. Two weekend shifts required monthly.

**On Call:** Two on\-call shifts required monthly.

**Salary:** $45\.00\-$61\.00 hourly. Compensation is determined by years of licensure.

**Work Location:** South San Diego County CA

**Travel:** Travel is required for patient visits.


Requirements:
**Responsibilities:**

* Develops written plan of care in coordination with an interdisciplinary Team (IDT).
* Oversees implementation of plan, evaluates and changes plan as necessary to meet patient/family needs.
* Responsible for the direction of care provided by LVN and HA in accordance with patient's plan of care.
* Responsible for the supervision of services provided by the LVN and HA per TEH policy and regulatory requirements.
* Communicates all changes to IDT and primary MD.
* Performs job duties in clinical areas as stated in clinical competency checklist, policies/procedures, standards of care, and critical competencies based on Scope of Practice.
* Maintains timely patient documentation using "point of care" electronic charting. s.Implements and maintains established hospice policies and procedures as well as Standards of Care and regulatory requirements.
* Provides health care instruction to patient and family members.
* Orients, instructs, and trains assigned personnel.
* Participates in providing 24 hour, seven days a week coverage to patients/families (on\-call and census fluctuation).
* Performs admission assessment and admission when necessary.
* Adhering to the E\-way standards is a requirement in performing all job duties

**Qualifications:**

* Must have Associates Degree, Bachelor Degree preferred.
* At least 12 months experience with 1\-2 years preferred in acute care.
* Current CA RN license.
* Current CA driver's license with proof of auto insurance.
* Current CPR certification and negative TB skin test.
* Prefer certification as hospice nurse.
* Pediatric experience preferred. a.Spanish speaking preferred.
* Computer skills (word processing), use of adding machine, calculator, fax, photocopier.
* Because this is a field position, must be able to drive in various conditions, including but not limited to winding/steep roads, night driving, and rural areas, and be able to enter homes with pets.

**We place a high importance on our employees and reward staff in several ways such as:**

* Competitive hospice industry compensation
* Benefits package with multiple plan offerings and generous employer contribution
* 401(k) Retirement plan with employer match
* Supportive work culture which encourages work life balance
* Paid Time Off, paid holidays \& floating holiday
* Employee development program managed by in\-house education department to support individualized orientation and professional growth needs.
* Tuition Reimbursement program
* Monthly mileage reimbursement
* Employee Referral Program


"The Elizabeth Hospice is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected Veteran Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law."
